race.description: Western Downs Civil Country Stampede Qualifier Hcp
race.comment: AIR WE GO (4) gets the nod after a Dalby third where he was beaten a length and a half at generous odds, with the stewards noting he jumped awkwardly and laid out around the home turn. His 1070m record is strong and the return of Jade Metcalfe is a further positive. DON'T TOUCH (8) is the main danger: she was doing her best work late when fourth in a BM65 at Toowoomba and had won a BM60 at Eidsvold as a well-supported favourite the run before, while her record at this distance is a major asset. ASTAPOR (5) backs up quickly and is knocking on the door. Loves this trip and gets his chance to put it all together and break a long run of outs. READY AND MABEL (6) just missed when resuming and should be better for that run. Can make her presence felt.
